item.title: HPD detective, suspect hurt in crash following chase through Midtown
item.description: A suspect and a Houston police detective are hospitalized after leading Houston police in a chase that ended up in a crash in Midtown on Thursday afternoon.

item.title: Bomb threat closes two Lone Star College campuses on Friday
item.description: Lone Star College Police Department issued an urgent safety alert for everyone on the LSC-Creekside campus due to a bomb threat, and bomb-sniffing dogs have been deployed to two locations as part of the ongoing investigation.

item.title: Go Red: Women, heart health & saving lives streaming in CW39+
item.description: CW39+ is streaming a Go Red Day conversation focused on women’s heart health, prevention, and lifesaving education. The program includes expert interviews, personal stories, and a hands-only CPR demonstration you can learn at home.

item.title: Local Democratic leaders address racial profiling lawsuit against ICE
item.description: Harris County Democratic Party (HCDP) leaders are filing a lawsuit to halt what they describe as ongoing racial profiling and the unlawful detainment of Latino United States citizens by ICE in Houston.
